items.difficulty_reason: The counted unit is the author's own lemma lemma-describe-pullback at source lines 747-758: for a sheaf F on X_etale the pullback pi_X^{-1}F is computed on Y by Gamma(Y_etale, f_small^{-1}F), and it satisfies the sheaf condition for smooth, syntomic, fppf, fpqc and ph coverings. The author's proof at source lines 760-797 first obtains the description from transitivity of pullback together with f_small = pi_X o i_f, then reduces the ph part to an equalizer computation for a surjective proper V -> U (one same-chapter result retained as context plus one cross-chapter criterion declared as a tagged pointer), transfers the smooth, syntomic and fppf cases from the ph case, and finally treats fpqc coverings in three cases (U and the U_i schemes; U a scheme; the general case) in which the author explicitly omits two verifications. The counted argument is therefore a complete multi-step reduction whose every in-chapter ingredient is retained inside the package.
